# Marmara Yemek Group website

- This is a Turkish-language, static HTML/CSS/JavaScript landing page.
- Keep the visual system responsive, accessible, and consistent with the warm ivory, forest-green, and terracotta palette.
- Do not invent company contact details, addresses, claims, or operational statistics; use clearly identified placeholders until verified information is provided.
- The contact form is client-side preview only unless a real service endpoint is explicitly configured.
- To preview the site, open `index.html` in a browser; no package installation is required.
